title: Surreal Psychedelic Portrait
description: A classical male head in profile with closed eyes emerges from overlapping translucent colorful circles in the center of a swirling vortex. The composition features vibrant grapes and leaves in the lower left, a large pink peony in the upper right, all set against a turbulent, multicolored cosmic background.
